sermons.title: Sermon 1904 | The Personal Pentecost and the Glorious Hope
Sermon 1906 | How To Become Fishers of Men

scripture.verse: "And Jesus saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men."

sermons.title: Sermon 1907 | "The Tender Mercy of Our God"

scripture.verse: "To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us, to give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death to guide our feet into the way of peace."
"If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean; yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me."

sermons.title: Sermon 1910 | The Heart of The Gospel

scripture.verse: "Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God. For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him."
